englishUI.scope: An enrolled fictional contributor used the production request form. The visible labels persisted after changing 2 packs to 3 and 8 per pack to 6. Done dismissed each keyboard. Purpose, destination and exclusions exposed their explicit accessibility names and kept their filled values. Request review preserved the original words and edited quantities. Cancel left zero submitted requests in the fixture.

priorUI.scope: The quantity-only candidate passed the numeric fields, both Done actions and request review before adding captions to the text fields.

The expanded run reached both quantity edits. It failed when XCTest could not find the filled multiline purpose field by its accessible name. The final code assigns explicit labels and identifiers to the purpose, destination and exclusions fields.

compiledDebug.scope: Ordinary arm64 Debug, with the independently reviewed widget guard included. Executable, assets, privacy, environment and embedded extensions passed verification.

compiledRelease.scope: The unsigned arm64 Release archive includes the capture field edits and widget guard. Executable, assets, privacy, environment and embedded extensions passed bundle checks.

spanishLargeTextFirstAttempt.scope: The app exposed the localized per-pack field with value 8 at the largest accessibility text size. The harness’s scroll gesture left that control outside the viewport, so the edit and keyboard checks did not run.

spanishLargeTextFollowUp.scope: A collection-scoped scroll in the test harness ended on the Spanish request warning at the largest accessibility text size. XCTest could not find the per-pack field at that position. Editing and keyboard dismissal remain unverified on this device and text setting.

remaining: US Spanish device and large-text verification
